question: o03
q: What's the US Federal Reserve's interest rate right now?

transcript.answer:
I can't give you the current US Federal Reserve rate. My tools don't have it.

I tried the RBA's international official interest rates table (F13), which includes the US federal funds target range. It returned no data points for any period, so I have no figure to quote. I'd rather not guess from memory, because the rate may have changed since my knowledge ends.

You can find the current target range on the Federal Reserve's website (federalreserve.gov, under Monetary Policy) or on the New York Fed's site. It's set at each FOMC meeting and given as a 0.25-percentage-point range, such as "X% to X.25%".

I can look up Australian figures for comparison, such as the RBA cash rate, CPI inflation, or the unemployment rate.
